description: Step through a sequence of arithmetic and compound assignment operations (+=, *=, -=) on intermediate to compute ageThisYear.

steps.description: Inside NumberGame.main, initialize value = 6, year = 2021, and birthYear = 1982.
Initialize intermediate = value * 2 (12.0), then update intermediate in place with += 5, *= 50, and -= 250.

steps.answer: Starting from 12.0, += 5 gives 17.0, *= 50 gives 850.0, and -= 250 gives 600.0.
steps.question: What value does intermediate hold right after line 25 runs (when execution reaches line 26)?

steps.description: Add year (2021) and subtract birthYear (1982) on lines 26-27 to get 639.0, take (int) (intermediate % 100) on line 29 to extract the last two digits 39, and print ageThisYear.
Pause at line 26 to verify that intermediate holds 600.0 before year and birthYear are applied.

title: Tracing Compound Assignments in a Debugger
